baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْتَفَّتِ (ل ف ف, word 1) governs the doubled ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ (س و ق, words 2-3).
baseline_models.mechanism: Physical wrapping acts on two shanks understood as the body's supporting stems. One support folds around the other, converting a stable two-part base into a single disabling knot.

activation_trace.role: Wrapping one thing around another supplies the interlocking action and its loss of separateness.
The shank as leg and supporting stem makes the doubled objects the body's paired load-bearing members.

changed_reading.before: Two legs merely meet in a bodily image.
changed_reading.after: The body's paired supports physically wrap into a knot and can no longer provide independent stance or motion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exact root س و ق is repeated in the two nouns at words 2-3 inside the wrapping construction at word 1.
baseline_models.mechanism: The س و ق inventory places supporting limb, forward impelling, and one-after-another sequence in one root field. Repetition supplies two positions in a motion system, while wrapping turns their outward succession back on itself.

activation_trace.role: Driving and impelling supplies outward motion latent behind the repeated root, though the surface nouns denote shanks.
Following one after another makes the doubled root readable as a sequence rather than static duplication.
Wrapping closes the sequential motion into a recursive bind.

changed_reading.before: The repeated ساق simply names the same body part twice.
changed_reading.after: The repetition carries a latent propulsion sequence whose two positions fold together, so motion becomes self-blocking.

context_deltas.mechanism: A limit is reached, a possible healer or incantatory intervention is sought, and separation is recognized immediately before the shanks wrap. This sequence turns the baseline knot into terminal failure of bodily coordination at a threshold no intervention reverses.

activation_trace.role: Physical wrapping supplies the final interlock.
The paired shanks are the supports whose coordination fails.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the threshold immediately before the bodily knot.
The protective incantation image supplies an attempted intervention at that threshold.
Distinguishing and separating supplies the irreversible parting immediately before the supports interlock.

structural_cues: Ayat 75:26-29 form an uninterrupted approach-to-limit, appeal, separation, and bodily-interlock sequence.
The branchless ت ر ق occurrence at 75:26 word 4 anatomically locates the reached limit but is used only as a structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endpoint, attempted intervention, separation, and wrapped shanks; I supply the arrow from that sequence to terminal loss of coordinated support. A live alternative is that the shanks figure converging hardships rather than physiology alone.

changed_reading.before: The shanks form a generic physical knot.
changed_reading.after: They are the body's supports failing together at the reached boundary of separation, after rescue has become ineffective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate move from two concrete ساق nouns to مَسَاق reactivates the same root as driving. Once the legs that carried the person are wrapped, agency changes sides: the former self-carrier becomes the carried or driven subject, with the Lord named as destination and sovereign endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Wrapping disables the prior means of self-carriage.
The leg and supporting-stem image identifies what formerly bore the person.
Lordship and sovereignty give the ensuing course its controlling endpoint.
Driving and impelling resolves the repeated focus root into externally directed conveyance.

structural_cues: Ayah 75:30 immediately repeats س و ق after its double occurrence in 75:29.
The grammar shifts from two concrete body-part nouns to a course or act of conveyance governed by a destination phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same root as paired supports and then as driving toward the Lord; I infer the transfer from self-carriage to externally governed conveyance. Alternatively, مَسَاق may foreground only destination or course, without coercive force.

changed_reading.before: Motion folds inward and stalls in the doubled shanks.
changed_reading.after: The stalled carrier becomes a hinge into another motion: the person who can no longer carry himself is now conveyed toward the sovereign destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Three prior acts of gathering span body, cosmos, and recitation; then separation is named one ayah before the focus. The ل ف ف mixed-gathering branch lets the wrapped shanks become the local junction where a whole separates while its components are forced into convergence.

activation_trace.role: A mixed gathering into one group lets wrapping carry convergence as well as physical enclosure.
Gathering scattered parts establishes bodily recomposition as the first convergence.
Gathering again scales convergence from the body to the celestial pair.
Gathering the recitation extends the same operation into ordered discourse.
Separation places the contrary operation directly beside the focus convergence.

structural_cues: The surah repeats gathering at 75:3, 75:9, and 75:17 before placing separation at 75:28 and wrapping at 75:29.
The focus doubles one body term, visually concentrating the surah-wide many-to-one motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated gathering, immediate separation, and a focus branch of mixed convergence; I infer that their adjacency deliberately collides opposite operations. They may instead be independent domain-specific uses with no designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The focus records only a local bodily entanglement.
changed_reading.after: It is a paradoxical junction: separation of the whole coincides with forced gathering of its paired supports.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human projects boundary-breaking action ahead, seeks an escape, finds no refuge, and prefers what is hastened while leaving what comes after. At the focus, the bodily supports of forward travel wrap together. The desired open trajectory is answered by locomotor closure.

activation_trace.role: Wrapping supplies the closure that physically arrests a route.
The legs as supporting stems are the means of advancing that become unavailable.
Deviation that tears a boundary supplies the chosen mode of pushing onward.
Frontness makes that transgressive project explicitly future-facing and directional.
Flight and escape supply the attempted alternate route.
Refuge is explicitly unavailable, closing the alternate route before the bodily closure.
Haste and precedence characterize the preferred immediate trajectory.
What comes after supplies the deferred horizon that was abandoned.

structural_cues: Directional terms recur from 75:5 through 75:21 before the focus disables the anatomy of forward motion.
The following مَسَاق at 75:30 preserves movement but removes it from the person's control.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forward transgression, escape, no refuge, haste, the later horizon, and bound supports; I infer a reversal in which chosen trajectory is revoked through the body. The interlock may instead be only physiological, without retrospective moral geometry.

changed_reading.before: The legs happen to tangle at a bodily crisis.
changed_reading.after: The very apparatus for going ahead closes on itself, reversing the person's earlier pursuit of an open future and escape route.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the terminal knot, the surah presents attachment, creation, completed form, pairing, capacity, life, and loss of life. Those operations recast the wrapped paired supports as a compressed boundary-state of a made body, not a self-sufficient final form beyond reconstitution.

activation_trace.role: Wrapping supplies a compacted relation between bodily parts rather than their disappearance.
The doubled supporting limbs preserve paired bodily structure inside the knot.
Attachment and adherence supply an earlier body-forming mode of joined matter.
Creating and bringing into existence make bodily configuration an effected process.
Completion and integrity of form contrast with the focus body's loss of coordinated form.
A counterpart joined to its mate activates the doubled shanks as a made pair.
Effective capacity supplies the power by which the terminal configuration need not be final.
Life returning to earth through rain and growth supplies a material image of renewal.
Loss of force and life names the terminal condition that capacity and enlivening answer.

structural_cues: Ayat 75:38-40 run from attached matter through making, proportion, pairing, and the life-death question.
The focus's doubled body part anticipates the explicit paired form at 75:39 without erasing the bodily crisis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joined matter, made and completed form, pairing, effective capacity, life, death, and wrapped paired supports; I infer that the knot is a reversible configuration within a creation sequence. The later verses may establish only general capacity, not reinterpret the exact leg image.

changed_reading.before: The wrapped supports look like the body's irreversible terminal shape.
changed_reading.after: They become a compressed boundary-state of a body whose attachments, form, pairing, and life are all presented as effects open to reconstitution.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus syntax is bodily and names no legal right, while the cited ل ف ف branch is sense-distant. It remains anchored in the focus root's explicit withholding-a-right branch and is activated by the surah's blame, accounting, report, excuse, truth, and denial sequence. Render only as an exploratory reciprocity resonance, never as a replacement gloss for ٱلْتَفَّتِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb's ل ف ف inventory includes withholding another's due, while its wrapped shanks visibly enact deprivation of bodily agency.

activation_trace.role: Wrapping a right away from its owner supplies the otherwise hidden withholding mechanism.
Driving supplies the loss of self-direction that makes the withholding recoil bodily.
Deserved blame activates an accountability frame for the focus constraint.
Counting and accounting give the withheld due a reckoning structure.
Delivered report makes prior action return as disclosed evidence.
Excuse and exculpation supply the attempted defense against that return.
Truthfulness names the obligation denied immediately after the focus sequence.
Contradiction of truth completes the context of withheld acknowledgment.

changed_reading.before: The body loses mobility through a physical interlock.
changed_reading.after: As a contained reciprocity image, withholding returns upon the agent: bodily agency is withheld while the denied account comes due.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ساق remains an anatomical noun and the language branches do not license replacing it with speech. It remains anchored in the focus verb's tongue-heaviness and clustered-letter branches, the repeated focus construction, and the nearby move-tongue, gather, recite, follow, and clarify sequence. Render as a formal or acoustic enactment secondary to the bodily reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus phrase clusters a wrapping verb with an exact repeated noun, while ل ف ف includes tongue-tied heaviness and clustered letters and س و ق includes sequential following.

activation_trace.role: Tongue-tied heaviness lets the wrapping action register as constrained articulation.
Letters meeting inside one word supply a compact verbal analogue to interlocked limbs.
Following one after another turns exact noun repetition into an audible sequence.
Motion opposed to stillness activates the controlled movement of articulation.
The tongue as speech organ makes the formal layer explicitly bodily.
Gathering dispersed units supplies the compositional operation behind the verbal knot.
Reading and recitation activate the phrase as performed sound rather than semantics alone.
Following in sequence gives the repeated units ordered succession.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign supplies the clarification that follows gathered recitation.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports a bodily knot.
changed_reading.after: Its clustered, repeated diction also performs a verbal knot: units gather, follow, and become difficultly compact at the moment the body does.

strongest_changes: The immediate س و ق repetition in مَسَاق changes bound legs into a transfer from self-carriage to externally governed conveyance toward the Lord.
The reached limit, attempted intervention, and separation in 75:26-28 turn a generic interlock into terminal failure of the body's paired supports.
Repeated gathering across body, cosmos, and recitation makes 75:29 the point where separation of a whole coincides with convergence of its parts.
The later attachment, making, pairing, life, and death sequence keeps the terminal bodily knot inside a form that is presented as reconstitutable.
summary.what_was_special: The same س و ق root names both paired shanks and the next ayah's مَسَاق, allowing anatomy, propulsion, passivity, and destination to exchange roles at the ayah boundary; the whole-surah gather/separate and form/re-form sequences preserve several simultaneous mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The doubled shank may remain strictly anatomical, while the propulsion and sequential branches are root-level resonances rather than active senses of the noun.
The gathering-versus-separation junction may be deliberate architecture or only a reader-supplied relation among independent uses.
The later creation sequence may contextualize divine capacity without making the exact focus configuration itself a reversible fold.
The accountability and verbal-knot outliers are branch-anchored but should remain secondary and explicitly exploratory.
